text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening calls as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$2.00 to C$3.00 a tonne on weekend rains on the Prairies and forecasts for more rain and cooler temperatures this week, lower CBOT soycomplex calls. November WCE canola crush profit margin fell to -14.47 Friday from -14.33 Thursday. Canada's dollar opened down at C$1.3923, rose to 82.34 yen and rose to 1.3318 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$1.00 to C$2.00 down to correct for Friday's rally and on better growing weather.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$1.00 to C$1.50 down on CBOT corn calls.
Trade talk of low test weights in Alberta's barley crop could be supportive if it was to reduce the deliverable supply.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne down on CBOT corn and wheat calls.
PEAS - US$0.50 to US$1.00 a tonne lower on CBOT soymeal calls and expected commercial offers in the October and December.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
